# seogeoworks

> An independent field guide to SEO, GEO, and the people reshaping how brands get found, understood, and remembered.

## Purpose

seogeoworks helps operators understand the gap between traditional SEO (being seen) and generative engine optimization (being chosen), then turn that gap into a practical plan.

## Core topics

- SEO vs GEO: where ranking and answer inclusion diverge
- Citation readiness: named experts, evidence, and machine-readable context
- Readiness audits and self-assessments for search visibility systems
- Field notes and research desk briefings for modern search
- Practical field guides for marketing, KOL, IT, and discovery queries

## Field guides

Browse the growing library at [Field guides](https://www.seogeoworks.hk/articles/).
